question: If people get used to higher incomes, how quickly does a raise stop making them happier, and does the pattern show up in what countries report?
finding: Across 138 countries, a doubling of income per person between 2009-11 and 2023-25 went with about one more point of life evaluation, so country averages show no treadmill over this period.
limit: Adaptation happens to individuals, and national averages over fourteen survey periods cannot show whether any person got used to their income.
